metadata.title: Contact multiplicity and a sharp six-map bound for collinear self-similar dendrites
metadata.abstract: Let $K\subset\mathbb{C}$ be the attractor of $n\ge2$ similarities $z\mapsto\lambda z+b_k$, $0<|\lambda|<1$, whose fixed points are evenly spaced on a line, and suppose that $K$ does not lie in a line. We prove that $K$ can be a dendrite only if $n\le6$, and that such dendrites exist for every $2\le n\le6$; no separation or finite-intersection hypothesis is imposed. Hence, for $n\ge7$, every connected $K$ of this kind has interior points or separates the plane. Neighboring pieces of $K$ meet in similar copies of a single contact set. In a dendrite exactly one first-level piece meets this set, whereas for $n\ge7$ at least $n-\lceil2\sqrt{n-1}\rceil\ge2$ do, a bound attained by explicit quadratic parameters. The proof combines a planar translation obstruction for replicated contact arcs with an estimate based on Jensen's formula. After normalizing to $z\mapsto t+z/c$, $t\in\{-n+1,-n+3,\ldots,n-1\}$, the connectedness locus is the closure, outside the unit disk, of the roots of monic integer polynomials of height at most $n-1$. The same estimate shows that, for $n\ge7$, every such polynomial with a non-real root $c$ satisfying $|c|^2\ge\lceil2\sqrt{n-1}\rceil+1$ has subleading coefficient of absolute value at most $\lceil2\sqrt{n-1}\rceil$, and that this bound is sharp. Accordingly, for $n\ge7$, at every non-real boundary point $c$ of the locus with $|c|>1$, each expansion $c=\sum_{j\ge0}d_jc^{-j}$ with integer digits $|d_j|\le n-1$ has $|d_0|\le\lceil2\sqrt{n-1}\rceil$.
metadata.comment: 20 pages, 5 figures. Ancillary files: exact-arithmetic verifier, figure programs and parameter-grid data

analysis.workSummary: 设平面自相似吸引子由 n≥2 个相同复收缩系数 λ 的相似映射生成，固定点在线上等距，0<|λ|<1，且吸引子不包含于直线。证明其为树状连续统必须 n≤6，并对每个2≤n≤6给出例子；无需分离或有限交假设。n≥7时连通吸引子必有内点或分离平面。相邻块共享一个接触集的相似副本：树状情形仅一个一级块接触该集，n≥7则至少 n−⌈2√(n−1)⌉≥2个，且显式二次参数实现下界。归一化后还刻画连通参数域为单位圆外高度≤n−1的首一整系数多项式根的闭包，并给出非实根及边界数字展开的尖锐次首系数限制。 所述非实根条件下，次首系数绝对值≤⌈2√(n−1)⌉；相应边界展开的|d₀|也≤⌈2√(n−1)⌉。
techniques: 复制接触弧的平面平移障碍
整系数多项式根与复进制展开
analysis.breakthrough: 以不要求分离的接触重数机制得到精确六映射阈值，并连接连通参数域与整数多项式系数。
analysis.limitations: 系数结论针对n≥7：非实根c须|c|²≥⌈2√(n−1)⌉+1才限制次首系数；边界展开c=∑d_j c^(−j)的首位限制需c非实、|c|>1及|d_j|≤n−1。不能推为任意自相似系统的六映射限制。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者明确ChatGPT辅助第3、4、6节证明发展及核查、验证与可视化代码、起草修订；Claude核查证明计算参考文献、起草包括Corollary1.3及Remark4.2的文字并制图。证明辅助有具体章节但未把某个核心思想首次归给模型，故不标ideas。
